license: CC0-1.0 default; explicit non-CC0 feature licenses excluded

selection.geographic_scope: Current atlas Japanese land mask, simplified at0.001 degrees, with0.025-degree coastal allowance; original OHM geometries retained whole.
selection.temporal_scope: Explicit ISO-like end_date in the past; no inferred dates or historic year slider.
selection.current_track_rejection: At least65% of100m-spaced samples(max300) within50m of current track in the same heavy-rail/tram family: excluded as an unproven historical identity of current track.
selection.current_station_rejection: Within120m of a current station in the same heavy-rail/tram family: conservatively excluded.
selection.duplicate_station_rejection: Same normalized name and end date within120m: retain one station rather than stop_position duplicate.
selection.identical_track_periods: Unended OHM periods with identical geometry screen out current identities. Multiple historical identities of identical track geometry are rendered once with all periods retained.

limitations: Community coverage is incomplete and varies geographically.
Dates describe a mapped feature period and do not necessarily prove whole-railway closure.
Proximity tests are conservative screens, not independently verified closure determinations.
Current alignment screening can omit former stations and railway sections near extant infrastructure.
No geometry is invented or connected across unmapped gaps.
